title: Tracks need a clock
hook: Footprints preserve a spacing, but speed needs more.

knows: Fossils and models can supply evidence about the past.
doesNotKnow: Both schematic prints show a 2 meter separation. Calculating distance divided by time also needs a time interval. Scientists may estimate dinosaur speeds with additional assumptions and trackway measurements; this toy example does not.

misconception: Distance alone determines speed without a time interval.
objective: Two prints are 2 meters apart in a toy trackway. Without a time interval, can you calculate speed as distance divided by time?
